name: br.com.mrocigno.bigbrother.network.ui.NetworkEntryDetailsActivity
description: This is part of Mrocigno's BigBrother diagnostic toolkit. When a user selects a captured request in BigBrother's network history, this screen shows its URL, request data, and response.
disableEffect: You will not be able to open individual request details in BigBrother; the app's network connections continue to work.
